nodes.name: New email (Gmail)
nodes.notes: Set a Gmail OAuth2 credential (see docs/securax/07-INTEGRATIONS.md §3). Swap for the Microsoft Outlook trigger if you use M365.

nodes.name: Classify locally (via gateway)
nodes.notes: Email bodies are Yellow/Red. Routing through the gateway keeps classification on the LOCAL model and redacts PII — nothing leaves the laptop.
